request: Owner requested current-style portal/Lab updates and deployment after checks; no BCP experiment or production Actions.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

design.scope: Read-mode refinement, not a replacement identity
exceptions: Existing stone palette and thin rules preserved at owner request
Read-mode documentation uses no stock photos, decorative video or new entrance animation
Plex 24px/mobile section and 18px subhead follow existing DESIGN.md; sidecar is stale
Lab static detector cannot resolve /assets routes as filesystem links; actual browser confirms typography/contrast. Existing trust-edge marking is semantic and outside this update.

negative_results: Initial Lab pytest: 201 passed/8 skipped, 5 localhost binds blocked by sandbox EPERM. The five passed on scoped loopback retry.
Initial portal preview used a non-40-character test revision and was refused by existing server validation; corrected to explicit all-zero preview-only revision.
One browser-test tool request timed out in automatic approval review before script creation; the reviewed local-only script was then created and ran successfully.

Draft attempted to extend the old browser script; preservation correctly rejected the frozen source. The script was restored byte-for-byte; new dedicated page tests and 18 separate browser checks cover BCP.
The first history rebuild required new translations and a temporary helper was initially addressed from the wrong directory. Corrected before commit.

The original preservation guard also pinned both presentation builders. Their accepted bytes are now verified in explicit archives; all other original files remain checked in place, and current builders remain source-hash pinned.
